sentences.text:
The present revision of the year 2020 is for quashing of the FIR and charge-sheet dated 11.07.2019 and 05.08.2019 in connection with CGR/2385/2019 arising out of Bhowanipur P.S. Case No. 204 of 2019 under Sections 120B/406/420/341/323/354/354B/324/506 of the Indian Penal Code and added Sections 376/511 of the Indian Penal Code, pending before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Alipore.
Ms. Manasi Roy, learned counsel for the State present in Court is appointed to represent the State in this case.
As none appears for the petitioner in spite of repeated calls since the date of listing, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected application, if any, stands disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.
Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial in accordance with law.
Learned counsel for the State to inform the status of this case to the concerned authority.

(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
